'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Ryan French DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan French]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Oops I did it again
* '''Username:''' Shadow13
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
